note: One question on two passages of one document. It rides doc_judge.py's replay pass as form `pair`: the file's document template is never sent. The named model is set when the prompts are built.

outcomes.line: compatible: both can be true, or they are about different things.
contradict: both cannot be true of the same thing at the same time.
cannot tell: the two passages do not let you decide.

accepted_note: An outcome is read by its normalised spelling against `accepted`, exact match only.
models_note: The candidate J1 loaded, on the auditor's route. A pair is a narrower question than J1's, so J1's verdict does not settle it either way.
